name: Yemen
famous_for: Dragon's Blood trees on Socotra Island, UNESCO mud-brick skyscrapers of Shibam ('Manhattan of the Desert'), and gingerbread houses of Sana'a.
tourists: Approx. 20,000 visitors (mostly Socotra eco-travelers); famous for Socotra dragon trees, Old City of Sana'a, and Mocha coffee heritage.
must_know: Shibam in Wadi Hadramawt features 16th-century mud-brick tower apartments rising up to 11 stories, the oldest vertical urban skyscrapers on Earth.
fun_fact: Socotra Island in the Arabian Sea is nicknamed the 'Galapagos of the Indian Ocean' because one-third of its plant species exist nowhere else.
